biotools.summary: fastQpick is a command-line tool and Python library used for sampling raw FASTQ reads with replacement. It is designed for performing bootstrap replicates, enabling detailed uncertainty quantification and statistical analysis in single-cell and RNA-seq experiments.
biotools.name: fastQpick
